describe: add lives, a timer, levels, a start screen or a game over screen
guide: Keep the rule's number in a named variable made once above the loop (lives = 3, time_left = 30). Change it inside the loop when the event happens, draw it after screen.fill with a font, and when it runs out, show a message rather than closing the window straight away. A life lost on touching something is lost once per touch, not on every frame of it: scene.touched(player, things) is true only in the frame a touch begins.
A timer is easiest from pygame.time.get_ticks(): remember the start time above the loop and work out the seconds left each frame.
